_comment: Single source of the Luckgram feature list for luckgram.cc/features and wiki.luckgram.cc. Edit here, run scripts/build.py; the wiki copies it with scripts/sync-features.py. Field "web" of a feature: its state in the web app (web.luckgram.cc) — "live" or "none" (not in the web app); "web_note" says what differs there.

web_note.zh: 网页版最多登录 20 个账号，不需要 Pro。
web_note.en: The web app holds up to 20 accounts, no Pro needed.

title.zh: 免费 10 个账号，Pro 不限数量
title.en: 10 accounts free, unlimited with Pro

description.zh: Telegram 官方一台设备最多登录 3 个账号。Luckgram 免费可以登录 10 个，开通 Luckgram Pro 后不限数量。个人、工作、客户和频道管理账号可以并排放着，各自的通知互不干扰，一点就能切换。
description.en: Telegram allows 3 accounts on one device. Luckgram lets you sign in to 10 for free, and as many as you like with Luckgram Pro, so personal, work, client and channel-admin accounts sit side by side, each with its own notifications, and you switch between them in a tap.

title.zh: 双重空间：第二个密码，打开另一套视图
title.en: Double Bottom: a second passcode with its own view

description.zh: 设置第二个密码，用它打开 Luckgram 时只显示你挑选的账号；用平时的密码则打开全部。别人在看你手机时显示什么，由你决定。
description.en: Set a second passcode that opens Luckgram with only the accounts you pick. Your usual passcode still opens everything, so you decide what shows up when someone else is looking.

title.zh: 隐藏聊天，不用删除
title.en: Hide chats without deleting them

description.zh: 滑动一下就能把聊天从列表里隐藏，既不删除，也不用退群。需要时一个手势就能找回。
description.en: Swipe a chat out of your list without deleting it or leaving the group. Hidden chats stay one gesture away whenever you need them.

title.zh: 免费打开商店版隐藏的频道
title.en: Open channels the store apps hide, for free

description.zh: 有些频道和群组只在 App Store 和 Google Play 版的 Telegram 里被隐藏。在设置里打开一个开关，Luckgram 就能打开它们：免费、永久有效，也不用登录任何网站。Telegram 对所有人封禁的频道，以及你所在地区依法屏蔽的频道，仍然打不开。
description.en: Some channels and groups are hidden only in the App Store and Google Play builds of Telegram. Turn on one switch in Settings and Luckgram opens them, free and permanently, with no website login. Channels that Telegram blocks for everyone, or that are blocked where you live, stay blocked.

title.zh: 用你的语言阅读消息
title.en: Read messages in your language

description.zh: 长按消息点“翻译”，译文直接显示在原文下面、同一个气泡里，点“撤销翻译”就恢复原样。也可以打开一键翻译按钮，外语消息旁边点一下就翻译。第一次翻译时先选要翻成哪种语言，之后 Luckgram 会记住；点译文上方的语言行可以随时更改。语音消息转成文字后也能翻译。免费使用，不需要 Telegram Premium：Telegram 翻译不了时，自动改用 Luckgram 的翻译。
description.en: Press and hold a message and tap Translate: the translation appears right under the original, in the same bubble, and Undo Translate puts it back. Or turn on the one-tap translate button next to messages in another language. The first time, you pick the language to translate into, and Luckgram remembers it; tap the language line on any translation to change it. Voice messages can be translated once they are turned into text. Free, with no Telegram Premium needed: when Telegram can't translate, Luckgram's own translation takes over.

title.zh: 发送前先翻译你写的内容
title.en: Translate what you write before you send it

description.zh: 用你习惯的语言写，在「+」面板里点“翻译”，或者长按发送按钮选“翻译”“翻译成…”。译文直接替换输入框里的文字，发出去之前你能先看到；每个聊天会记住各自的目标语言。
description.en: Write in the language you think in, then tap Translate in the + panel, or hold the send button and choose Translate or Translate to…. The text is replaced in the input bar, so you see it before anything is sent, and the language is remembered for each chat.

title.zh: 语音消息直接看，回复直接说
title.en: Read voice messages, dictate your replies

description.zh: 一点就把任意长度的语音消息和圆形视频转成文字，开会时、在嘈杂的地铁上都方便。也可以直接说话代替打字，边说边出字；可选的 AI 整理会去掉口头禅、补好标点。免费使用，不需要 Telegram Premium。
description.en: Turn voice messages and round videos of any length into text with one tap, handy in a meeting or on a noisy train. Dictate instead of typing and watch the words appear as you speak; optional AI cleanup removes filler words and fixes punctuation. Free, no Telegram Premium needed.

title.zh: 更清爽的输入框，常用功能都在「+」里
title.en: A cleaner input bar with everything under +

description.zh: 输入框一行只留表情、输入区、语音和「+」按钮。点「+」打开宫格面板：相册、拍摄、文件、位置、联系人、投票，还有快捷回复、语音输入、AI 写作和翻译。喜欢原来的布局？在“Luckgram 功能”里关掉精简输入栏即可。
description.en: The input bar keeps just emoji, the text field, voice and a + button. Tap + for a grid with Photos, Camera, File, Location, Contact and Poll, plus Quick replies, Voice input, AI writing and Translate. Prefer the old layout? Turn the compact input bar off in Luckgram Features.

title.zh: 用保存好的快捷回复作答
title.en: Answer with saved quick replies

description.zh: 把常用的回复存起来，比如“我晚点到”“稍后回电”，在输入框的「+」面板里一点就能发出。
description.en: Keep the answers you send all the time, such as running late or I will call you back, and send them with one tap from the + panel in the input bar.

title.zh: 转发时隐藏原发送者
title.en: Forward without the sender's name

description.zh: 转发消息时打开“隐藏发送者名字”，消息就像是你自己发的，不会带上原作者。
description.en: When you forward a message, turn on Hide sender's name and it arrives as if you wrote it, without the original author attached.

title.zh: 一键选中某人的全部消息
title.en: Select every message from one person

description.zh: 长按一条消息，就能一次选中这个人在聊天里发的所有消息（不限 100 条），方便复制、转发、收藏或删除。
description.en: Long-press a message and select everything that person wrote in the chat at once, not just the last hundred, ready to copy, forward, save or delete.

title.zh: 一键存到收藏夹
title.en: Save to Saved Messages in one tap

description.zh: 直接在消息菜单里把帖子或消息存起来，不用打开转发页面再去找“收藏夹”。
description.en: Keep a post or message for later straight from the message menu, without opening the forward screen and looking for Saved Messages.

title.zh: 把相册视频发成圆形视频消息
title.en: Send gallery videos as round video messages

description.zh: 选一段相册里已有的视频，像在聊天里现拍的一样，发成圆形视频消息。
description.en: Pick a video you already recorded and send it as a round video message, the same way as one you film in the chat.

title.zh: 通话录音，附文字稿和 AI 总结
title.en: Record calls, with a transcript and AI summary

description.zh: 一点就能录下通话，iPhone 和 Android 都支持。挂断后录音会存到收藏夹或你指定的聊天，附带可搜索的文字稿和 AI 总结，谈好了什么一目了然。各国对录音的法律规定不同，录音前请先告知对方。
description.en: Record a call with one tap, on iPhone and Android. When you hang up, the recording lands in Saved Messages or any chat you choose, with a searchable transcript and an AI summary of what was agreed. Recording laws differ by country; let the other person know before you record.

title.zh: 看清空间被谁占用，按需清理
title.en: See what takes up space and clear it

description.zh: “存储空间”会显示视频、照片、文件和音乐各占多少空间，你可以按类型清理。缓存上限可在 1 GB 到不限之间任选，媒体保留时间从 1 小时到永久，还能给每个聊天单独设置。
description.en: Storage Usage shows how much space videos, photos, files and music take on your phone, and you clear the types you choose. Pick any cache size from 1 GB to no limit, keep media from one hour to forever, and set different rules for each chat.

title.zh: Telegram ID、注册时间和可点击的简介链接
title.en: Telegram ID, sign-up date and clickable bio links

description.zh: 个人资料页会显示账号的 Telegram ID（一点即可复制）、账号大致的注册时间，简介里的链接也能直接点开。
description.en: Profiles show the account's Telegram ID, which you can copy in a tap, an estimate of when the account was created, and links in bios that open when you tap them.

title.zh: 关键词文件夹，帮你找出相关聊天
title.en: Keyword folders that find chats for you

description.zh: 用一个词建文件夹，比如“发票”或“航班”，所有提到这个词的聊天都会归进来，关键词会高亮显示。
description.en: Create a folder from a word, such as invoice or flight, and it gathers every chat that mentions it, with the word highlighted.

title.zh: 给任何联系人写私人备注
title.en: Private notes on any contact

description.zh: 在对方的资料页写一条备注，比如在哪认识、订过什么。只有你能看到，打开和对方的聊天时会显示在顶部，所有备注还能一起搜索。
description.en: Write a note on someone's profile, such as where you met or what they ordered. Only you can see it, it shows at the top of your chat with them, and you can search all your notes at once.

title.zh: 查看联系人在共同群里说了什么
title.en: See what a contact said in groups you share

description.zh: 打开资料页的“动态”标签，就能看到对方最近在你们共同所在的群里发的消息，点一下就跳到原处。只显示你在这些群里本来就能看到的消息。
description.en: Open a profile and the Activity tab lists that person's latest messages in the groups you are both in, with a tap to jump to each one. It only shows messages you could already read in those groups.

title.zh: “发现”标签：广场和附近的人都在这里
title.en: A Discover tab for Square and People Nearby

description.zh: 底部第三个标签是“发现”，广场和附近的人都在这里。设置移到了“个人资料”标签里，点“设置”按钮进入。
description.en: The third tab at the bottom is Discover, where Square and People Nearby live. Settings moved one level down: open the Profile tab and tap Settings.

title.zh: 想认识附近的人时，才让附近的人看到你
title.en: Meet people nearby, only when you choose to

description.zh: 打开“在附近可见”，就能看到附近同样打开了的人，一点就能发消息。别人只能看到你在多远的范围内，比如“500 米内”，看不到你的位置；24 小时后自动关闭。任何人都可以举报或拉黑。
description.en: Turn on Visible to people nearby and you see others around you who did the same, then message them in a tap. People see only how far away you are, such as within 500 m, never where you are, and it turns itself off after 24 hours. You can report or block anyone.

title.zh: 广场：Luckgram 社区的公开动态
title.en: Square: public posts from the Luckgram community

description.zh: 发布文字、图片和短视频动态，所有 Luckgram 用户都能看到，发布后立即公开。浏览「最新」和「热门」，点赞、评论，或从作者主页直接发起私聊。遇到不当内容可以举报，也可以随时屏蔽任何用户。
description.en: Share text, photos and short videos to a public feed that every Luckgram user can see. Posts go live as soon as you publish them. Browse Latest and Hot, like and comment, or start a private chat from the author's profile. You can report inappropriate content and block anyone at any time.

title.zh: 扫一扫加好友
title.en: Scan a QR code to add a friend

description.zh: 点聊天列表右上角的「⋮」菜单，选“扫一扫”，扫对方的 Telegram 二维码就能打开对方资料、群组或链接。同一页面还有“我的二维码”，可以直接给别人扫。
description.en: Open the ⋮ menu at the top of the chat list and tap Scan to read someone's Telegram QR code and open their profile, a group or a link. My QR code is on the same screen, ready to show.

title.zh: 聊天里的 AI 助手
title.en: An AI assistant inside your chats

description.zh: 像平常聊天一样提问：让它举例讲解一个话题、总结或改写一段长文，或者一步步解一道数学题。任何聊天里的消息、链接和文件都能直接转给它处理。
description.en: Ask a question, get a topic explained with an example, have a long text summarized or rewritten, or a math problem worked through step by step, in a chat like any other. Share a message, a link or a file with it straight from any chat.

title.zh: 用总结快速跟上热闹的群聊
title.en: Catch up on a busy chat with a summary

description.zh: 回来发现几百条未读？先用几行字看清结论、日期和待解决的问题，再决定要不要往上翻。也可以直接问，比如“客户最后答应了什么”，点任意一条就能跳到对应的原消息。
description.en: Coming back to hundreds of unread messages? Get the decisions, dates and open questions in a few lines before you scroll. Ask your own question, such as what the client agreed to, and tap any point to jump to the messages behind it.

title.zh: 把随手写的几个字变成得体的回复
title.en: Turn rough notes into a reply

description.zh: 随手打下你想说的意思，从几条贴合对话的润色回复里挑一条，发送前还可以再改。
description.en: Type what you mean, however quickly, and choose from polished replies that fit the conversation. Edit the one you pick before you send it.

title.zh: 发送前一键润色任何消息
title.en: Polish any message before you send it

description.zh: 在任何聊天里打完字，长按发送键选“AI 写作”，选你想要的效果：表达更好、更正式、更亲切、更简短，或者只改语法。文字会在输入框里直接改好，语言保持不变。
description.en: Type in any chat, long-press the send button, pick AI writing and choose what you want: better wording, more formal, friendlier, shorter or just fixed grammar. The text is rewritten in place, in your language.

title.zh: 各种任务的 AI 智能体，也能自己做一个
title.en: AI agents for every task, or build your own

description.zh: 挑一个专做这件事的智能体，比如旅行规划、文案、语言陪练或资料查询，像和普通联系人一样聊天。有特别的需求？用你自己的指令做一个专属智能体。
description.en: Pick an agent made for the job, such as a travel planner, copywriter, language tutor or researcher, and chat with it like with anyone else. Need something specific? Create your own agent with your own instructions.

title.zh: 在智能体市场挑现成的 AI 智能体
title.en: Browse ready-made AI agents in the market

description.zh: 在 AI 助手里打开“智能体”，切到“市场”：按分类浏览、搜索，看清每个智能体能做什么，一点就开始聊天。新的智能体由我们在服务端上架，不用更新应用。标有 Pro 的智能体需要 Luckgram Pro。
description.en: Open Agents in the AI assistant and switch to Market: browse by category, search, read what each agent does and start a chat in a tap. New agents are added on our side, no update needed. Agents marked Pro need Luckgram Pro.

title.zh: 一句话生成图片
title.en: Create images from a sentence

description.zh: 描述你想要的画面，图片就出现在聊天里。可以直接发到任何聊天或频道、保存下来，或者再生成一版。
description.en: Describe the picture you want and it appears in the chat. Send it to any chat or channel, save it, or ask for another version.

title.zh: 按你频道的风格写帖子
title.en: Channel posts written in your channel's style

description.zh: 给一个主题，就能得到一篇可以直接修改的帖子，语气和你以前发的保持一致。可以改短、加表情或翻译，在同一个页面直接发布。
description.en: Give a topic and get a ready-to-edit post that matches the tone of your earlier posts. Make it shorter, add emoji or translate it, then publish from the same screen.

title.zh: Luckgram Pro：更多 AI、更多账号、没有赞助消息
title.en: Luckgram Pro: more AI, more accounts, no sponsored messages

description.zh: Luckgram Pro 是 Luckgram 自己的会员，和 Telegram Premium 无关。开通后 AI 对话和翻译的每日次数更多，每月另送 AI 点数，可以用高级模型；聊天总结范围更大，还能追问；可以用 Pro 专享智能体、登录账号不限数量、使用云备份；频道里不再显示 Telegram 赞助消息。订阅页会列出当前的全部权益和剩余点数。
description.en: Luckgram Pro is Luckgram's own membership, separate from Telegram Premium. It raises your daily AI and translation limits, adds monthly AI credits for the premium model, longer chat summaries with follow-up questions, Pro-only agents, unlimited accounts and cloud backup, and hides Telegram's sponsored messages in channels. The subscription page shows the current perks and your remaining credits.

title.zh: 账号加密备份到云端
title.en: Back up your accounts to the cloud, encrypted

description.zh: 选择要备份的账号，设置备份密码。备份在手机上加密后才上传，Luckgram 只保存自己解不开的密文。换新手机（iPhone 和 Android 都行）时，登录任意一个账号，选“从云端恢复”，输入密码，账号就都回来了，不用逐个登录。忘记密码将无法恢复。
description.en: Pick the accounts to back up and set a backup password. The backup is encrypted on your phone before upload, so Luckgram stores only data it cannot read. On a new phone, iPhone or Android, sign in to any one account, choose Restore from cloud, enter the password and your accounts come back without signing in to each one. Forget the password and the backup cannot be restored.

title.zh: 加入 Pro 会员私密群
title.en: Join the private group for Pro members

description.zh: Pro 会员在“Luckgram 功能 → Luckgram Pro”里一点就能用一次性邀请链接加入 Luckgram 的 Telegram 私密群。会员到期后会自动移出。
description.en: Pro members can join Luckgram's private Telegram group with a one-time invite from Luckgram Features → Luckgram Pro. When the membership ends, you leave the group automatically.

title.zh: 扫码、粘贴链接或导入订阅就能加代理，登录前就能用
title.en: Add proxies from a QR code, a link or a subscription, even before you sign in

description.zh: 连不上 Telegram？登录流程的每一页右上角都有代理按钮，收验证码之前就能添加 SOCKS5 或 MTProto 代理。新增两种加代理的方式：一是扫码或粘贴链接，扫一下代理二维码，或者粘贴 tg://、t.me 或 socks5:// 链接，代理就加进列表，不用逐项填服务器和端口；二是导入订阅，粘贴 Clash / mihomo 订阅网址，里面的 SOCKS5 节点一次全部导入，之后可以一键刷新，订阅删了，它导入的代理也一起删。代理列表里，每个 SOCKS5 代理下面会显示它的出口国家和 IP，最上面的“直连”一行显示不用代理时你自己的出口。登录后，在聊天列表右上角「⋮」菜单的最上面就能找到“代理配置”。
description.en: Can't reach Telegram? The proxy button sits in the top-right corner of every sign-in screen, so you can add a SOCKS5 or MTProto proxy before you get your code. There are now two faster ways to add one. Scan a proxy QR code or paste a tg://, t.me or socks5:// link, and it goes straight into your list, with no server and port to type. Or paste a Clash or mihomo subscription URL to import all its SOCKS5 proxies at once; refresh it with one tap, and deleting the subscription removes the proxies it added. The proxy list shows the exit country and IP of every SOCKS5 proxy, and a Direct row at the top shows your own exit without one. After signing in, find Proxy settings at the top of the ⋮ menu in the chat list.

title.zh: 看清验证码发到了哪里
title.en: Know where your sign-in code went

description.zh: Telegram 把登录验证码发到你另一台设备上的 Telegram 应用、而不是短信时，验证码页会说明去哪里找；点“收不到验证码？”可以查看没有其他已登录设备时怎么办。
description.en: When Telegram sends your sign-in code to the Telegram app on another device instead of by SMS, the code screen explains where to find it, and How can I receive the code? covers what to do if no other device is signed in.
